This also marked the return of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the World Cup finals, with the Bosnians making their first appearance since 2014. Switzerland began their World Cup campaign with a draw, and would go on to top the group after winning their next two group games. Canada finished as runners-up, thanks to their first ever World Cup win against Qatar, and both teams advanced to the round of 32. Bosnia and Herzegovina finished in third based on goal difference, and their performance secured them as one of the eight best third-place teams, allowing them to progress to the round of 32.
